Thermaltake TR2 700W Gold  Incorporating various high-quality components, the new TR2 Gold – models are rated from 450W to 700W – saves energy through its high efficiency of up to 90% and accommodates any mainstream build with the most demanding requirements. An embedded intelligent cooling fan delivers excellent airflow at an exceptionally low noise level. Additionally, the Single +12V rail design enables non-stop usage with stable and reliable performance. Ultra Quiet Fan TR2 Gold Series adopts 12cm cooling fan with intelligent RPM control guarantees cool performance and silent operation. Multiple Connectors The cables used for TR2 Gold are all sleeved. TR2 700W Gold connector’s specification as below: 80 PLUS Gold Certified and Kaby Lake-Ready TR2 Gold Series saves energy through its high energy efficiency of up to 90% and is 80 PLUS® Gold certified. Additionally, TR2 S Gold Series has been optimized to work with Intel’s new, Seventh-generation Kaby Lake processors to achieve maximum energy savings. High Quality Capacitors High quality capacitors enable non-stop usage with stable and reliable performance, no more capacitor explosion and leakage. Massive and Dedicated Single +12V Output TR2 Series is equipped with powerful +12V rails, superior performance under all types of system loading.
